plugin.name: JARVIS Avatar
plugin.description: An animated avatar that shows the Home Assistant voice assistant pipeline state.

sizes.1x1: The face, its state colour ring, and a small state icon.
sizes.2x1: The face with state ring, state name text below.
sizes.1x2: Larger face, state name and animated details.
sizes.2x2: Full face, state name, last command text, and glow effects.
sizes.2x3: Full face, state history, last commands, and animated halo.
